title: HUMAN ANATOMY 1 General   Musculoskeletal Anatomy pdf
mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are responsible for movement of the body parts like arms, legs, trunk and pumping of the heart."
Muscles are responsible for movement of the body parts like arms, legs, trunk and pumping of the heart.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is responsible for most body movements, smooth muscle is found in the walls of hollow organs and tubes and moves substances through them, and cardiac muscle is found in the heart and pumps blood."

Skeletal muscle is responsible for most body movements, smooth muscle is found in the walls of hollow organs and tubes and moves substances through them, and cardiac muscle is found in the heart and pumps blood.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are used exclusively for muscle tissue."
Several specific terms are used exclusively for muscle tissue.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is responsible for most of the structural strength of the skin."
The dermis is responsible for most of the structural strength of the skin.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an autoimmune disease of muscle of unknown origin."
Myasthenia gravis is an autoimmune disease of muscle of unknown origin.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the most common cause of emergency abdominal surgery in children and it often leads to peritonitis."
Appendicitis is the most common cause of emergency abdominal surgery in children and it often leads to peritonitis.

Skin without blemishes is considered attractive, whereas acne is a source of embarrassment for many people.

Simple diffusion is the movement of particles (solutes) from a region of higher solute concentration to a region of lower solute concentration.

exceptions are those of the wrist, ankle and kneecap.

Oogenesis is the process of forming an ovum (egg) by meiosis (in animals, by mitosis in the gametophyte in plants) in specialized gonads known as ovaries.

Gametogenesis is the process of forming gametes (by definition haploid, n) from diploid cells of the germ line.

Euchromatin is the less compact DNA form, and contains genes that are frequently expressed by the cell.

Cartilage is a somewhat elastic, pliable, compact type of connective tissue.

Endocytosis refers to the formation of vesicles to transfer particles and droplets from outside to inside the cell.

The two main cavities are called the ventral and dorsal cavities.

Ossification is the process by which bone is formed.

A tissue is an organization of a great many similar cells that perform a specific function with varying amounts and kinds of nonliving, intercellular substance between them.

Homeostasis is a key word in modern physiology.

Anatomy is the science of the structure of the body.

Osmosis is the diffusion of solvent or water molecules through a selectively permeable membrane.

Joint is a junction between two or more bones or cartilages.

A tendon is a tough, flexible band of fibrous connective tissue that connects muscles to bones.

Arthritis is the leading cause of disability in people over the age of 55.

Areolar connective tissue is the most widespread connective tissue of the body.

Interphase is the period between successive cell divisions.

Muscular 'wasting' (reduction in size) is a feature of lower motor neuron paralysis and generalized debility.

Muscle is a soft tissue found in most animals.

Embryogenesis is the step in the life cycle after fertilisation - the development of the embryo, starting from the zygote (fertilised egg).

Spermatogenesis is the process of forming sperm cells by meiosis (in animals, by mitosis in plants) in specialized organs known as gonads (in males these are termed testes).
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the study of the body by organ systems."
Systemic anatomy is the study of the body by organ systems.

Cardiac muscle is a highly specialized tissue restricted to the wall of the heart.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the basic living unit of all organisms."
The cell is the basic living unit of all organisms.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an important factor in promoting lubrication."
Mobility of the joint itself is an important factor in promoting lubrication.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a double layer of phospholipid molecules."

Periosteal arteries are the arteries of periosteum being especially numerous beneath the muscular and ligamentous attachment.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a very contagious skin condition."
Scabies is a very contagious skin condition.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are those in which bones are connected by fibrous tissue."
Fibrous joints are those in which bones are connected by fibrous tissue.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a special type of cell division that occurs in the production of the gametes, or eggs and sperm."
Meiosis is a special type of cell division that occurs in the production of the gametes, or eggs and sperm.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the process by which the three germ tissue layers of the embryo, which are the ectoderm, endoderm, and mesoderm, develop into the internal organs of the organism."
Organogenesis is the process by which the three germ tissue layers of the embryo, which are the ectoderm, endoderm, and mesoderm, develop into the internal organs of the organism.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are used by animals to ensure that only one sperm fertilizes a given egg: the fast block to polyspermy and the slow block to polyspermy."
Two mechanisms are used by animals to ensure that only one sperm fertilizes a given egg: the fast block to polyspermy and the slow block to polyspermy.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a basic life science that helps us learn about the body structure."
Human Anatomy is a basic life science that helps us learn about the body structure.
